### Added

- **Admin groups.** A new "Admin group" switch in the New group dialog makes you the group's only admin: only you can add or remove members, change the name, description, avatar, disappearing timer and pins, and you can delete any message for everyone. The info sheet shows "Moderated group · admin: X" with an Admin badge, and the admin's messages carry an **Admin** chip. Other members' clients enforce the same rules; wire-compatible with ArcaneChat admin groups (core patch #19). Refs #177

### Fixed

- **Profile keys showing "-".** Contact fingerprints are read correctly again from chatmail core 2.66's changed encryption info, so avatars and profile keys show the real key.
- **One-letter-wide bubbles.** A threaded message that shared its row with the unread or read-marker line no longer collapses into one letter per line.

### Under the hood

- Upstream status of every core patch is recorded in VENDORISSUES.MD (assessed 2026-10-29); the README documents Cryptex and velta.cc/join invites.
